Use the frozen unnamed small MAIN02/MASK worker model as a provisional, imperfect representation. This imagined scene is not source evidence. In 80–140 English words, give a brief immediate appraisal, short first-person English-rendered speech, and the next observable action by the worker. Stop before another person replies or any unprovided result occurs. Do not invent prior dialogue, received knowledge, permission, abilities, physical contact or successful outcomes. Retain plausible mistakes and uncertainty. Every participant is explicitly an adult and the scene is nonsexual. Source and paired contrasts are visible to this same informed author; no independent judge, held-out test or Japanese-voice validation is claimed.

SCENE: At an imagined guild gathering, the worker, Vanir and an adult clerk named Nera stand before a few adult spectators. Vanir has publicly invited Nera to demonstrate a paper trick. The worker admires Vanir and wants him to display the impressive composure she values. Nera hesitates; no consent, demonstration or later reply is supplied. No one is in physical danger. Vanir has just made one private explanation that the worker clearly hears and believes.

His exact explanation is: I sincerely want to teach Nera the trick and help her perform it.

Return only the requested first response.

SCENE: In an imagined ordinary town, the worker is delivering a nonhazardous surprise-party program to an adult customer named Taro. She arranged the wrong entrance and cannot complete the delivery before the meeting; she treats this as her own professional failure. An adult venue steward asks which customer hired her. She believes public acknowledgment would embarrass Taro. There is no emergency, legal demand, prior confidentiality promise or supernatural power in this scene. She can decline to answer and leave through the open entrance. No response after her next action or completed repair is supplied. She has just read a genuine message from Taro.

The exact message reads: I would rather people here did not know I hired you.
